scripts.check: node scripts/check-release-version.mjs && node --check backend/src/server.js && node --check backend/src/auth.js && node --check desktop/main.cjs && node --check desktop/preload.cjs && npm --prefix backend run db:validate && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.android:add: npm.cmd run frontend:build && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/patch-capacitor-gradle.cjs && npm.cmd run frontend:build && cap sync android && node scripts/patch-capacitor-gradle.cjs
scripts.android:open: npm.cmd run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:build: npm.cmd run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug --parallel --build-cache --no-daemon
scripts.android:build:offline: npm.cmd run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug --offline --parallel --build-cache --no-daemon
scripts.android:release:apk: npm.cmd run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease --parallel --build-cache --no-daemon
scripts.android:release:aab: npm.cmd run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease --parallel --build-cache --no-daemon
scripts.desktop:electron:start: npm.cmd --prefix frontend run build && npm.cmd --prefix desktop start
scripts.native:windows:release: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/flutter-native.ps1 pub get && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-flutter-windows.ps1 && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/flutter-native.ps1 build windows --release --no-pub --dart-define=WEBCORD_API_URL=https://webcordes.ru/api
scripts.native:release: npm.cmd run native:android:release && npm.cmd run native:windows:release
